guest.source_image: OS X Mavericks Install DVD.dmg (archive.org item OSXMavericksInstallDVD)
guest.hypervisor: qemu-system-x86_64 11.1.1, accel=tcg thread=multi, machine pc-q35-6.1, cpu Penryn,+sse4.1,+sse4.2,+ssse3
guest.boot: OVMF (edk2) -> Clover r5175 (SMBIOS iMac13,2, CPU QEMU=1, KernelPm=1) -> macOS
guest.display: vmware-svga, 1600x900, 32bpp, 1 user pt == 1 guest px (no HiDPI in guest)

capture_rules: C1 All metrics are @1x: 1 pt == 1 px. HiDPI (@2x) values are computed, never sampled.
C2 Timing/animation facts are NOT frame-derived (TCG is not isochronous): they carry source='literature' and confidence<=medium.
C3 Every numeric fact MUST name its evidence: a capture id present in captures/index.json, or an explicit external source.
C4 Derived/computed values carry deriv='<formula or reference id>' so they can be re-derived, not re-measured.
C5 No Apple binary or Apple-copyright asset is committed; only derived numeric facts, our own diagrams and our own drawings.
